arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Seth Waxman argued the Lanham Act remedies market misappropriation by competitors.
Ms. Sullivan argued the FDCA promotes honesty and fair dealing for consumers.
Justice Kagan noted a potential conflict between FDA findings and Lanham Act claims.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: POM Wonderful wants a court to stop Coca-Cola from using labels it deems misleading. Coca-Cola wants the court to dismiss the case because federal food laws control labeling.

sections.heading: What each side wants
paragraphs: POM Wonderful wants a private right to sue competitors for misleading labels.
Coca-Cola wants courts to dismiss private suits over FDA-approved labels.

sections.heading: What each side says
paragraphs: POM Wonderful argues the Lanham Act protects businesses from competitor misrepresentation.
Coca-Cola argues federal food laws preempt private claims about required labels.
